decisions.reason: The stronger mixing-quality target does not change the selected bowl capacity or form; the existing capacity priorities remain compatible with it.
Splash control is independently addressed by another clause of message 61 and already has a complete same-message MODIFY; the mixing-quality change adds nothing to it.
The mixing-quality target motivates consideration of whisk options but does not select a new whisk configuration; the separate same-message AMBIGUOUS Event already captures the unresolved choice.
The candidate already requires smooth, controlled, froth-preserving dispensing, and the stronger mixing-result target does not alter those dispensing attributes.
Mixing texture and foam quality do not change the bowl or spout cleanability requirements, which are independently addressed in message 61.
A stronger desired mixing result does not necessarily change the existing general reliability requirement for event use.
The source message reaffirms the existing solenoid approach but the mixing-quality modification does not change the candidate's valve mechanism or actuation behavior.
The desired matcha texture does not necessarily alter the enclosure dimensions, side profile, or accommodation of deep bowl wells.
The mixing-quality change has no effect on the machine's brand text, placard placement, or intended viewer.
The source message reiterates no-drip and leak-prevention expectations separately, but the stronger mixing-result target does not change the existing containment requirements.
The desired mixing result does not require a change to the 120V input source, battery policy, or established power architecture.
The stronger matcha texture and foam target does not alter the DJ-turntable visual theme.
